command.name: exact__GN_best_final_fresh
command.rule: Use raw measured u directly; no material-A or further inverse-PD preparation. Baseline loading flag does not filter any of four declared dynamic controls.

cases.velocity_metric_semantics: Preserved root translational freejoint qvel RMS; angular body qvel norm is frame invariant, not a new COM-velocity gate.
cases.nonpad_metric_definition: Maximum across PRE ticks of the SUM of positive Fn over every phone contact with non-designated hand geoms; same aggregation as original two-pad gate. old_two_pad also includes all positive Fn on geom41.
cases.control_scope: Planned50Hz controller only; trace pre_executed_ctrl20 is actual perPRE-tick command. Legacy trace ctrl20 is last command and ctrl_margin20x2 describes initial source only. Raw integration receipts protect callback state; no full-MjData certificate.
cases.native_loop_and_physical_success_gates_f: frozen functional_tripod_dynamics_v3, unchanged after insertion of explicit control hook and schedule fields
